title: Betti-Whittaker periods under duality: variations and applications
summary: One of the authors (Chen) had previously proved a result on the behavior of Betti-Whittaker periods under duality for cohomological cuspidal automorphic representations of ${\rm GL}_n/{\mathbb Q}$ under some regularity assumptions while using their relation to $L$-values as an anchor in his proof. In this article we prove a generalization of this result to ${\rm GL}_n$ over any number field $F$ without any regularity assumptions and without recourse to $L$-values, while using the outer-automorphism of ${\rm GL}_n$ as the main tool.
